caption:
In the latest year on record, over ten million NRIs came back to visit India. That's more than half of everyone who visited India from abroad.

NRI visits to India hit 10.62 million in 2024 - the most recent figure the Ministry of Tourism has published (government tourism data typically takes over a year to fully release) - up 52% from 6.98 million in 2019, before the pandemic. NRIs now make up more than half of all international arrivals to India, and they stay longer and spend more per trip than typical foreign tourists. India's total tourism receipts hit $35 billion that same year.

This isn't tourism in the usual sense. It's millions of people choosing to spend their vacation days going back, not just sending money back.

Sources: Ministry of Tourism (Government of India), ThePrint
